title: MedicalEntity
description: The most generic type of entity related to health and the practice of medicine.

type.title: Type
type.description: The RDF type(s) of this item.

code.title: Code
code.description: A medical code for the entity, taken from a controlled vocabulary or ontology such as ICD-9, DiseasesDB, MeSH, SNOMED-CT, RxNorm, etc.

funding.title: Funding
funding.description: A [[Grant]] that directly or indirectly provide funding or sponsorship for this item. See also [[ownershipFundingInfo]].

guideline.title: Guideline
guideline.description: A medical guideline related to this entity.

legalStatus.title: Legal Status
legalStatus.description: The drug or supplement's legal status, including any controlled substance schedules that apply.

legalStatus_text.title: Legal Status (text)
legalStatus_text.description: The drug or supplement's legal status, including any controlled substance schedules that apply.

medicineSystem.title: Medicine System
medicineSystem.description: The system of medicine that includes this MedicalEntity, for example 'evidence-based', 'homeopathic', 'chiropractic', etc.

recognizingAuthority.title: Recognizing Authority
recognizingAuthority.description: If applicable, the organization that officially recognizes this entity as part of its endorsed system of medicine.

relevantSpecialty.title: Relevant Specialty
relevantSpecialty.description: If applicable, a medical specialty in which this entity is relevant.

study.title: Study
study.description: A medical study or trial related to this entity.
